content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 26-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ECHS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the ECHS Delhi Recruitment 2026 is 26th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ECHS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 30 vacancies announced for various Medical, Para Medical, and Non-Medical Staff positions across ECHS Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for ECHS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: For the Clerk post, candidates must be a Graduate or possess a Class-I Clerical Trade qualification (Armed Forces) with a minimum of 05 years of work experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for a Medical Officer in ECHS Delhi?
faq.answer: The salary for a Medical Officer position in ECHS Delhi is Rs. 95,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Does ECHS Delhi offer contractual positions?
faq.answer: Yes, the ECHS Delhi recruitment for these posts is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for ECHS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will primarily be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the application form for ECHS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of ECHS, which is www.echs.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the address to send the application form?
faq.answer: The application form along with self-attested photocopies of testimonials should be submitted to OIC, Stn HQ (ECHS Cell) Delhi Cantt-110010.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age limit mentioned for these posts?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify an age limit. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for detailed age criteria and any applicable relaxations.
